children: HWH International entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement with Smart Dynamics Technology to acquire all shares of Hearty Nova for $1. Hearty Nova holds a 51% stake in a Hong Kong joint venture with China Gas Holdings that plans to develop a natural gas processing plant in Nigeria. HWH expects to invest about $1.173 million alongside $1.127 million from China Gas Holdings, with additional project funding anticipated from third-party borrowings. Closing is subject to customary conditions.
